summary: Iteration 23: End-to-end verified File Reassignment Block, Reassignment Clean Slate, and all 6 Files reports endpoints (daily, rejected, quality, growth-partner, bank-performance, tat-metrics). Backend pytest: 11/11 passed (test_iter23_reports_reassignment.py). Files Dashboard UI shows all 6 report buttons (Daily Report, Rejected, Growth Partner, Bank Perf., TAT, Quality) + Policy, Export, Import. Admin Users page shows 'Growth Partners' terminology. Admin Dashboard filter shows 'All Growth Partners' and 'Active Growth Partners' cards. Files count = 454 as expected. Login endpoint returns 'token' (not 'access_token'). Reassignment block correctly skips status='file' leads (skipped_files array), and pre-file leads reset to status='new' with cleared last_call_outcome on new GP.

minor.issue: None of the files_crm.py report endpoints (daily, rejected, quality, growth-partner, bank-performance, tat-metrics) require authentication — they are open to anonymous callers. This exposes sensitive business KPIs and should be protected with Depends(get_current_user) or require_admin.
files_crm.py creates its own MongoClient at module import instead of reusing utils.database.db — duplicate connection pool. Consider consolidating.
Pre-existing (iter 22): /leads/count does not reuse build_leads_query, so no_status/archive/is_invalid handling differs from /leads listing.

issues: Line 210 of VerifiedCallStats.js still reads 'Telecallers need to use the BANKEZEE Connect Mobile App to sync their call logs.' — Telecaller → Growth Partner terminology update missed here.
Line 58 CSV export header is still 'Telecaller' (should be 'Growth Partner').
Reports.js line 497 CSV header 'Telecaller', line 695 CSV header 'Telecaller', line 1582 dropdown 'All Telecallers' — Growth Partner terminology not applied to Reports page.

Persistent React hydration console errors: <span> cannot be a child of <select>/<option>/<tbody>/<tfoot>/<table>/<tr> (from ve-dynamic preview-tooling wrappers). Non-blocking but noisy — same as iter 22.
FilesDashboard: 'Each child in a list should have a unique key prop' React warning (pre-existing).
FilesDashboard: 'Cannot infer the option value of complex children' warning on <option> element (pre-existing).

action_items: Add auth dependency (require_admin / get_current_user) to all /api/files/reports/* endpoints — currently open to anonymous requests.
Update remaining Telecaller → Growth Partner terminology in: VerifiedCallStats.js (line 58 CSV header, line 210 empty-state text), Reports.js (lines 497, 695 CSV headers, line 1582 dropdown label).
Backend: consolidate files_crm.py duplicate MongoClient into shared utils.database.db to avoid two connection pools.
Leftover from iter 22: align /api/leads/count query builder with build_leads_query for consistent filter semantics.
critical_code_review_comments: SECURITY: files_crm.py report endpoints (/reports, /reports/daily, /reports/rejected, /reports/quality, /reports/growth-partner, /reports/bank-performance, /reports/tat-metrics) have NO auth guards. Anonymous curl to /api/files/reports/daily returns full metrics. Must add Depends(require_admin) or at minimum get_current_user.

leads.py assign_leads correctly implements File Reassignment Block + Clean Slate (status reset to 'new', last_call_outcome cleared, reassigned_from_status recorded, call_logs flagged is_previous_agent_history). Good.
files_crm.py creates its own AsyncIOMotorClient at module import (lines 21-23) — separate connection pool from utils.database.db. Cleanup recommended.

Telecaller terminology is inconsistently applied — data-testid, variable names, and API paths still use 'telecaller' (which is fine because they're internal), but user-facing strings in VerifiedCallStats.js and Reports.js still say 'Telecaller'. Missed by the terminology update pass.
files_crm.py is now ~1900 lines — recommend splitting into files_reports.py, files_documents.py, files_policies.py, files_migration.py for maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% for review checklist (all 6 report buttons visible; Growth Partner terminology present on Users/Dashboard/FilesDashboard)
